name: UDW
title: Dream Wall
summary: Wall-mount 10G Cloud Gateway with WiFi 6 AP, 17-port PoE switch (420 W), NVR storage, dual PSUs.

f.storage: 512 GB microSD (NVR) + 128 GB SSD (detections); microSD up to 1 TB

extra.port_layout_raw: 1 GbE RJ45=17 (4 PoE++; 4 PoE+; 4 PoE) — only 12 of 17 listed as PoE; remaining 5 presumably non-PoE
extra.psu_note: (2) hot-swap bays, (1) PSU pre-installed — redundancy needs 2nd PSU purchased

gotchas: Not currently sold in the store (price null) — modern path is a UCG-Fiber/UDM-Pro-Max + PoE switch + WiFi 7 AP.
Only one PSU pre-installed; redundancy requires buying the second hot-swap PSU.
LAN copper is 1 GbE — no multi-gig to WiFi 7 APs; only 12 of 17 RJ45 ports supply PoE (4 PoE++ / 4 PoE+ / 4 PoE).
NVR on microSD (max 1 TB) — no HDD bay; heavy Protect use wants a UNVR.
Integrated AP is WiFi 6, no 6 GHz.
3.5 Gbps IPS — below the 5 Gbps of the cheaper UCG-Fiber.
best_for: wall-closet small office wanting one box
